sharedQuantize: one merge map across ALL frames of a character (prevents animation palette flicker)
outline: full 1px dark outline (#141019 family) via engine outline()
light: top-left via engine shade(); never pillow-shade

castle.canon: navy micro-dot shirt, olive pants, brown satchel strap, dark swept hair w/ quiff, full beard, dark thin-frame glasses

pickles.canon: wine velvet dress w/ pink hem, long copper spiral curls, translucent rose-gold cat-eye glasses (frames #b8824a), choker + gold pendant, red lips

animation.walk: 4 frames (contact/pass/contact/pass), sequence [0,0,1,2,2,3] for 60/40 contact weighting, ~9 FPS
animation.facings: down/up/side; side flips horizontally for left
